observation.note: Selected the main front panel (largest -Y-normal quad, area 9.936, agent_id 96) identified via inspect_region across the whole mesh, filtering by normal and area.

reason: inset the front face to create a footprint for the driver recess; a real, unplanned constraint discovered here -- inset_region always shrinks uniformly around the ORIGINAL face's own centroid, so it can't directly produce an off-center (upper-middle) recess. Decided to inset centered first, then reposition afterward with move_selection once the recess exists, rather than needing a new op.

result_state.note: resulting footprint measured 1.6 wide x 2.44 tall -- a tall rectangle, not the roughly-square ~1.6x1.6 intended for a circular driver silhouette. Unexpected outcome, addressed in the next decision.
